correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the un-divided six-wave Floquet cell determinant at ak=mπ: the nonzero 2k² factor leaves (k²−1)(sin(bk)cosθ₂+sin(ck)cosθ₁)=(-1)^m(k²+1)sin((b+c)k). Independent cosine coordinates fill [−1,1]², proving the exact iff including k=1 and all sine-zero boundaries without division by sin(ak). For rationally independent 1,b/a,c/a, Weyl–Kronecker and Δ=|sin x|+|sin y|−|sin(x+y)|>0 off the measure-zero coordinate sine-zero loci prove the strict inequality for a density-one set. Continuous determinant sign changes then yield spectral interior, not merely individual fibers. Independent irrational witness has ratio 0.006056515926075707<1. This is not a proof about all spectral gaps.
